INSERT INTO artwork (id, round_id, email, playlist_id, title, layout_version, status, closed) VALUES (#{id}, #{roundId}, #{email}, #{playlistId}, #{title}, #{layoutVersion}, #{status}, #{closed})
mapper.sql: id, round_id, email, playlist_id, title, layout_version, status, score, ai_comment, model, attempt_cnt, fail_reason, like_cnt, is_anchor AS anchor, closed, evaluated_at, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM artwork WHERE round_id = #{roundId} AND email = #{email} AND is_anchor = false
SELECT FROM artwork WHERE round_id = #{roundId} AND is_anchor = true AND score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY score DESC, id ASC
SELECT FROM artwork WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE artwork SET status = 'SCORED', score = #{score}, ai_comment = #{aiComment}, model = #{model}, fail_reason = NULL, attempt_cnt = attempt_cnt + 1, evaluated_at = now() WHERE id = #{artworkId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE artwork SET status = 'FAILED', fail_reason = #{failReason}, attempt_cnt = attempt_cnt + 1, evaluated_at = now() WHERE id = #{artworkId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE artwork SET status = 'PENDING', fail_reason = NULL WHERE id = #{artworkId} AND status = 'FAILED'
mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS music_id, (m.location::real[])[1] AS pc1, (m.location::real[])[2] AS pc2 FROM music m WHERE m.location IS NOT NULL AND NOT m.is_unplayable ORDER BY point((m.location::real[])[1], (m.location::real[])[2]) <-> point(#{x}, #{y}) LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT percentile_cont(0.02) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (m.location::real[])[1]) AS x_min, percentile_cont(0.98) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (m.location::real[])[1]) AS x_max, percentile_cont(0.02) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (m.location::real[])[2]) AS y_min, percentile_cont(0.98) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (m.location::real[])[2]) AS y_max FROM music m WHERE m.location IS NOT NULL AND NOT m.is_unplayable

mapper.sql: a.id AS id, a.title AS title, a.email AS email, a.status AS status, a.score AS score, a.ai_comment AS ai_comment, a.like_cnt AS like_cnt, a.created_at AS created_at, a.closed AS closed, (SELECT count(*) FROM artwork_point p WHERE p.artwork_id = a.id) AS music_cnt

EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM artwork_like l WHERE l.artwork_id = a.id AND l.email = #{requesterEmail})
false AS liked_by_me,
(a.like_cnt + a.score * #{aiWeight} / 100.0) AS rank_score FROM artwork a WHERE a.round_id = #{roundId} AND a.status = 'SCORED' AND a.is_anchor = false ORDER BY rank_score DESC, a.score DESC, a.created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM artwork WHERE round_id = #{roundId} AND status = 'SCORED' AND is_anchor = false
